verdict.rationale: Gladia's pricing page describes usage-based billing tied to audio volume ('pay only for the audio you process', credit top-ups, 50€ free), so cost does scale with audio processed. However, the evidence shows no per-minute or per-hour rate and no itemized add-on prices, so an agent could not actually compute a job's cost from what is shown. Missing for 10: published per-minute/hour rates, itemized add-on pricing (e.g. diarization, translation, PII redaction), and a machine-readable or agent-accessible pricing source.
